mapper.select: SELECT support_requests.*, users.username, support_request_comments.*, users.username FROM support_requests JOIN users ON support_requests.user_id = users.user_id JOIN support_request_comments ON support_requests.thread_id = support_request_comments.thread_id WHERE thread_id = #{threadId};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO support_requests(title, description, user_id) SELECT #{thread.title}, #{thread.description}, user_id FROM users WHERE username = #{thread.author};
INSERT INTO support_request_comments(thread_id, description, user_id) SELECT #{comment.threadId}, #{comment.description}, user_id FROM users WHERE username = #{comment.author};
mapper.update: UPDATE support_requests SET last_update_time = CURRENT_TIME(), last_update_by = (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE username = #{input.author}), status = "CLOSED" WHERE thread_id = #{input.threadId};
UPDATE support_requests SET last_update_time = CURRENT_TIME(), last_update_by = (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE username = #{input.author}), status = "OPEN" WHERE thread_id = #{input.threadId};
